summary: The implementation successfully addresses all five requirements (REQ-1 through REQ-5) with robust authentication infrastructure. However, a critical security concern exists: passwords are stored in plain text in the backend, violating REQ-2's core mandate for password hashing.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement password hashing in the backend using SHA-256 or Motoko's native crypto functions to never store passwords in plain text
missing_requirements.reason: Backend stores passwords directly without hashing. In backend/main.mo, the addUser function stores passwords as-is: 'users.add(username, password)'. No hashing implementation is evident in the truncated code.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module for transforming old session data structure to new schema with expiresAt field
hallucinated_features.reason: Migration logic in backend/migration.mo was not requested in any requirement. The BuildRequest focuses on implementing new authentication, not migrating existing data structures.

hallucinated_features.description: Enhanced password validation requiring uppercase letters and special characters
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 acceptance criteria specify 'minimum 8 characters, mix of letters and numbers'. The implementation in frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts requires uppercase letters and checks for special characters, exceeding the specified requirements.
